About the Fellowship

The Raghunathan Family Fellowship supports early-career scholars undertaking research with a South Asia focus at Harvard. Applicants must meet the PhD completion and recency conditions. The checked posting does not state a closing date, so that needs confirmation before submission.

Research Areas

  • South Asia studies
  • Interdisciplinary research
  • Postdoctoral research

Funding and Duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPostdoctoral fellowship
Stipend / salaryUSD 68,000 for a 12-month appointment; shorter terms prorated
Duration12-month appointment; shorter terms prorated

Eligibility and Requirements

Candidates must have received their PhD no later than February 2027, and the doctorate must have been awarded within the past five years.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusPosting available; closing date unconfirmed
Deadline / consideration roundNot stated on checked official posting
LocationUnited States

About Harvard University

Harvard hosts research fellowships through its academic schools, institutes and centres. Each fellowship has its own research focus, eligibility rules and application process, separate from doctoral admission.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://academicpositions.harvard.edu/postings/16755

Source: academicpositions.harvard.edu - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Not stated on checked official posting - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: Not stated on checked official posting. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
